name: TN-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Tim Burchett running with large financial advantage
Prediction markets price Democratic chance at only ~6%
No polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The R+17 district, Burchett's incumbency, and his roughly six-to-one fundraising edge over Barnett leave Democrats with no clear path, and markets agree at about a 6% Democratic win probability. With no polls or expert ratings to move the estimate, the forecast stays anchored to fundamentals.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Barnett competitive, or a major scandal or independent-candidate surge, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Tim Burchett seeks another term in a Knoxville-area district that leans about seventeen points Republican, making a Democratic upset a steep climb. His challenger, Michaela Barnett, has raised a modest amount and enters the final stretch with limited cash, while Burchett has out-raised her several times over and holds a large war chest. No outside groups are active on either side, and no public polls or expert ratings cover the race.

Prediction markets give Democrats only a small chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. Barring an unexpected development, this seat is expected to remain in Republican hands by a wide margin.
